pg_hoop.title: The hoop
pg_hoop.speaker: protagonist
pg_hoop.text: A hoop on a pole, no net, and a backboard that was repainted and then rained on. The line of the court runs under the pole rather than meeting it.
pg_hoop.repeat_text: The hoop, the pole, the line running underneath.

record.text: The painted court line runs under the near hoop's pole instead of meeting it.

pg_bench.title: The bench
pg_bench.speaker: protagonist
pg_bench.text: There is a torn plastic noodle packet on the wooden bench. It has gone flat. A bit of silver lining shows at the open end.
pg_bench.repeat_text: An empty noodle packet, the bowl on the front facing up.

record.text: An opened instant-noodle packet was left on the wooden bench by the court.

pg_frame.title: The climbing frame
pg_frame.speaker: protagonist
pg_frame.text: A frame of four rungs and a top bar. The paint is new except on the third rung and the top bar, where hands have been.
pg_frame.repeat_text: Four rungs, a top bar, two worn places.

record.text: The climbing frame in the yard has been repainted everywhere except where hands go.

pg_court.title: The court
pg_court.speaker: protagonist
pg_court.text: Two hoops, a centre line, and a key painted at each end. The paint at the far end is a shade darker, as if that half was done a year later.
pg_court.repeat_text: Two hoops, two keys, two shades of paint.

record.text: The two halves of the yard court were painted at different times.

pg_container.title: The container
pg_container.speaker: protagonist
pg_container.text: Just a creased sheet on the floor. A thin blanket has been pushed aside, and old newspapers lie scattered near the opening. No one is here.
pg_container.repeat_text: A sheet, a blanket, a few newspapers. The container is still empty.

record.text: Someone spread a sheet on the floor of the blue container. The blanket was left in a heap.

pg_tyres.title: The tyres
pg_tyres.speaker: protagonist
pg_tyres.text: Three tyres stacked against the shed wall and one lying flat, all of them painted the same green as the shed door at some point, and worn back to black where hands go.
pg_tyres.repeat_text: The tyres, painted once, worn where hands go.

record.text: The tyres against the shed were painted the same green as the shed door.

pg_return_board.title: Equipment return board
pg_return_board.speaker: protagonist
pg_return_board.text: The red steps lead to the fire door in the school wall. For the alley, use the alley gate opposite. A strip under the main sheet has the same stamp printed backwards.
pg_return_board.repeat_text: Fire door for the school, alley gate for the alley. The lower stamp is still backwards.

record.text: The yard board marks the fire door back into school and the gate towards the alley. The lower strip shows the return stamp in reverse.

pg_chalk_guide.title: Court marking guide
pg_chalk_guide.speaker: protagonist
pg_chalk_guide.text: Red cord and a strip used to mark the court. One peg hole is round, the other is a slot. There is enough chalk on the offcut to see what prints through each one.
pg_chalk_guide.repeat_text: A round hole and a slot. The chalk gives both away.

record.text: The court marking guide has one round hole and one slotted hole; both leave distinct chalk marks.

pg_tap.title: Tethered drain cap
pg_tap.speaker: protagonist
pg_tap.text: A tap with a red wheel handle. The concrete underneath has gone chalky. The drain cap hangs from the pipe, clear of the grate.
pg_tap.repeat_text: The cap is still on its hook. The grate underneath is clear.

record.text: The drain under the yard tap is unobstructed. Its cap is chained to the standpipe.

pg_cabin_papers.title: Old newspapers
pg_cabin_papers.speaker: protagonist
pg_cabin_papers.text: The corner of the top newspaper was cut off. Only half the date is left. The pages beside it are intact.
pg_cabin_papers.repeat_text: The date stops at the cut edge.

record.text: One old newspaper in the blue container has a corner clipped off, leaving only part of the date.

pg_site.title: The building under construction
pg_site.speaker: protagonist
pg_site.text: TODO · the building, seen over the hoarding
